0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The astute artisan is openly staring.

48.original: Pardon me for staring─I couldn't help but notice that you have the posture of one who has trained in martial techniques. Might I beg your assistance with a small matter?

49.original: A friend of mine has recently joined the guard, you see. I was hoping to put my skills to work in crafting her armor more durable than the standard-issue fare, but she's already been stationed out in Lakeland.

50.original: I have her measurements, of course, but I find myself unsure of which parts of the garment will need to be reinforced, and which will need to hang a bit loose for mobility's sake. Would you be willing to demonstrate a few common stances for me?

51.original: Thank you! In that case, could you begin by showing me your usual <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>battle stance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>?

52.original: You needn't be self-conscious─just move how you usually do.

53.original: Hmm... I may need to add a bit more give around the shoulders. Would you mind throwing a few punches as well? As if you were <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>boxing<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

54.original: This perhaps goes without saying, but you needn't actually hit anyone. I only wish to see how you move when you throw a punch.

55.original: I see─the entire torso needs to be able to twist. And the knuckle portion of the gloves could likely use a bit more padding...

56.original: I believe I understand what alterations to make. You've been a great help─thank you.

57.original: I must say that what you're wearing seems quite finely made, but if ever you do find yourself in need of new equipment, come and find me. I would be happy to offer you a reduced rate on my custom work!
